$comment: OWASP ZAP baseline findings (medium or high) accepted on purpose, each with the reason it is not a vulnerability here and an expiry. Checked by .github/workflows/security-scan.yml; anything else, or an expired entry, fails the scan.

accepted.name: Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens
accepted.reason: The flagged forms (sign-in, sign-up, password reset) are Next.js Server Actions, which reject any request whose Origin does not match the host; session cookies are SameSite=Lax and every JSON write checks the origin (guardWrite). ZAP looks for a hidden token field only.

accepted.name: Cross-Domain Misconfiguration
accepted.reason: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * appears only on public static files served by Vercel (stylesheets, icon, robots.txt, sitemap.xml), never on pages or API routes; those files carry no user data and the header never allows credentials.

accepted.name: CSP: style-src unsafe-inline
accepted.reason: style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' only as the fallback for browsers without CSP level 3. Current browsers enforce style-src-elem with the per-request nonce (an injected <style> is refused, verified in Chromium) and allow inline styles only as attributes (style-src-attr), which React writes and which cannot run code.
